title: Cartwise+ Membership Pause Rules
content:
**Rule.** Only Cartwise+ Membership plans whose terms offer a pause can be paused, and only from active. A pause must be requested at least the plan's cutoff before the next renewal date. The cutoff is counted in calendar days backward from the end of the current period, so the last day to ask is the current period end minus the plan's request-cutoff days, inclusive. A membership may be paused no more than the plan's allowed number of times in any rolling 365-day window, counted as the pause-history entries on the membership whose pause start date falls in the 365 calendar days ending today. No fee is charged and no benefit applies while paused, and Priority Delivery upgrades and credit expiry clocks keep running. The membership resumes on the day after the pause end date, or earlier on the customer's request, and a new paid period starts on the resume day with a renewal fee.

**Retired clause.** "A pause starts on the next renewal date and lasts between the plan's shortest and longest pause in calendar days." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Conditions to pause

| Condition | Evidence |
|---|---|
| The plan offers a pause | the plan held, and the plan's pause terms |
| The membership is active | the status on the membership record |
| The request is made on or before the current period end less the cutoff days | the current period end on the membership record |
| Fewer pauses than the plan allows in the rolling 365 days | the membership's pause history |

## The cutoff illustrated (hypothetical, cutoff of 1 day)

| Current period ends | Request made | Within the cutoff? |
|---|---|---|
| 20 July | 18 July | yes |
| 20 July | 19 July (20 July less 1 day) | yes — the last day to ask is inclusive |
| 20 July | 20 July | no |

## Rolling-window count illustrated (hypothetical, 2 pauses allowed)

| Pause-history entries whose pause started in the last 365 days | Another pause allowed? |
|---|---|
| 0 | yes |
| 1 | yes |
| 2 | no |

## While paused and on resuming

No fee is charged and no order benefit applies while the membership is paused. Upgrades and credit expiry clocks keep running during the pause. On resuming — the day after the pause end date, or earlier at the customer's request — a new paid period starts on that day with a renewal fee.

superseded_clauses: A pause starts on the next renewal date and lasts between pause_min_days and pause_max_days calendar days.
